name: Ranger Frenzy: Worn Out allies are skipped by a later Frenzy (#1952)
contract: Frenzy 520492 (Ranger, SpellFamilyName 27) reads 'Enrage all nearby allies, increasing their haste by $s1% for $d. After being affected by this spell, allies cannot benefit from similar effects for $804457d.' Spell.dbc gives it three effects on TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID: effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CASTING_SPEED_NOT_STACK (65) and effect 1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE (192), both BasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = 30, and effect 2 SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL 804457 'Worn Out', a 5 min SPELL_AURA_DUMMY marker. Nothing read Worn Out, so every Frenzy in the window hasted the ally again. spell_ascension_ranger_frenzy removes units that already carry Worn Out from all three effects' target lists during target selection, before the launch-phase trigger applies this cast's Worn Out. Expected: the first Frenzy gives a grouped ally 30/30 and Worn Out; a second Frenzy while Worn Out is present gives the ally no Frenzy aura and leaves its Worn Out running rather than refreshing it; once Worn Out is gone a third Frenzy gives the ally 30/30 again.
